== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Captain Khurgee: the entry “Captain Khurgee” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 32. Image for [[Captain Khurgee (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 32 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's text block.

SHA-1 <code>67883bdee6a8712f6a7100a6d651ee8a0ac98b3d</code>, SHA-256 <code>86e5449f645e7c51e857cf3cae46125ac59e80594a868639604aad575739bed1</code>.
